# dsh-official-reasoning-effort

> Reasoning-effort control for gateway / custom providers — using the official
> composer UI, not a
re-implementation of it.
## What it solves

Many gateway APIs (e.g. `deepseek-v4.1-flash` on a relay) expose no `reasoning
effort` knob of their

own, yet the request still succeeds upstream. The official
composer only renders the **Effort** row

when the model declares reasoning
levels — so gateways without a declaration show no such option at

the model declares reasoning
levels — so gateways without a declaration show no such option at all.
## How it works (official components only)
This plugin does **not** draw its own UI. It has two small halves:

1. **Host half (data fill)**: every model in `llm-pi-ai` that lacks
`reasoningEfforts` gets `off / l

ow / high / max` added — additively; an existing
declaration (including `false`) is never overwritte

n. Once the model carries
the field, `llm-pi-ai` reports `reasoning: true` with the level list, and

the
**official** `ModelSelect` composer renders its own 模型 / 推理等级 rows with
the drill-down level pic

ker by itself. Nothing is re-implemented.
2. **Browser half (one hint line)**: the model picker pane

l is found by its
official `aria-label`, and when the currently selected provider+model is one
whose

levels were supplied generically, a CSS `::after` pseudo-element adds a
single small line at the bo
ttom of the official panel:

> 上游未声明思考强度，此处为通用档位，上游可能忽略或拒绝。
>
> Upstream does not declare reasoning effort; these are generic lev
els and may be ignored or rejected.

It is hidden for models whose levels are genuinely declared upstream. The
match is on the **provider

+ model pair** (`data-provider-id` /
`data-model-id`), so the same model id served by a different,

reasoning-capable
provider is never flagged.
## Levels

- Default four, identical to the official control: `Off` / `Low` / `High` / `Max`.
These are the ids

`off / low / high / max`; `llm-pi-ai` renders each level's
label by capitalising its id, so the off

icial picker shows exactly
Off / Low / High / Max with no UI changes.
### Why `reasoning: high` is written too

Declaring `reasoningEfforts` alone yields **five** rows (an extra `Default`).
The official picker bu

`defaultEffort` is derived by `llm-pi-ai` from the **provider profile's**
`reasoning` field (`reason

ingInfo(model, profile.reasoning)`). A provider that
declares no `reasoning` has no `defaultEffort`,

hence `Default` + four levels =
five rows. The official `dsh-llm-deepseek` adapter always sets one

(falling back
to `high`), which is why the built-in provider shows four rows.

The plugin therefore writes `reasoning: high` for any provider whose levels it
filled (High is the o

fficial "default balance for most tasks"). An explicitly
configured `reasoning` is never overwritten

, and providers needing no fill are
left alone.

- A model that natively publishes more (or fewer) levels keeps its own list —
the official picker re

nders whatever the model declares;
- On send the level maps to the wire value following the `pi-ai`

adapter
(defaulting to the level name; overridable in config).
## Install

`lib/` is prebuilt and committed, so installing from GitHub needs no local build.
No client bundling

step is required either — the browser half is a plain
side-effect module.
## Configuration

Zero-config by default: it discovers every existing `llm-pi-ai` provider and
fills generic levels fo

r models that declare none. Override only for special
gateways / exclusions / per-model handling:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Fields
| Field | Meaning |
| `auto` | Auto-discover all providers (default `true`); when `false`, only providers listed under `

providers`. |
| `efforts` | Override the wire-value map for all providers (default `off/low/high/max

→ same name`). |
| `defaultEffort` | Provider default effort written when filling levels (default `

high`, the official default). |
| `syncDefaultEffort` | Set `false` to skip writing the provider def

ault (the official menu then shows an extra `Default` row). |
| `providers.<id>.efforts` | Override

wire values for one provider. |
| `providers.<id>.disabled` | Exclude a provider. |
| `providers.<id

>.models.<model>.efforts` | Override wire values for one model. |
| `providers.<id>.models.<model>.d
isabled` | Mark a model as non-reasoning (`reasoningEfforts: false`). |
## Safe defaults
